messages:
sasha: Pushed a new prototype: 'filter summarizer' collapses many chips into a single expandable element. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/filter-summarizer
ben: looked — neat. question: on expand does it show groups or just the active chips? I like grouped view so you can clear per group
clare: accessibility: summary should be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. when expanded, focus should land on the first actionable element. add aria-live updates when items are pinned/cleared
toni: pin UX thought: instead of moving rows, show a pinned mini-strip that can be docked left/right or auto-hide. dock preferences saved per-user. makes compare table stable
sasha: agreed on stability. also thinking of a mini-cheat sheet that lists keyboard shortcuts (c = compare, p = pin, / = focus filter) accessible via '?' in header
a11y-bot: Reminder: keep live region polite for non-critical updates. Provide skip link target for pinned strip ("Skip to pinned versions")
ben: badges: propose adaptive badge sizing — for narrow view show icon+abbr (Latency -> L), on hover expand to full label. must avoid color-only meaning and provide title attr/tooltips
clare: tooltip accessibility: ensure tooltip appears on focus too, and is reachable via aria-describedby. for adaptive badges, make accessible-name full label always present (aria-label) even if visually abbreviated
toni: microcopy: change badge text from "perf:90ms" to "90 ms median latency". remove ambiguous colons and shorthand. also use comma separators for throughput e.g. "12,400 qps"
sasha: animation: when pinning show a subtle ripple and announce "Version X pinned" via aria-live. keep animation short (120ms) so it doesn't delay interactions
a11y-bot: Checkpoint: animation duration <200ms, provide prefers-reduced-motion variant that disables ripple and uses instant state change
ben: about filter summarizer: suggestion to show a small stacked-dot visual inside the chip representing groups, and a count like "3 filters". tapping expands into accessible panel with clear-all and undo in toast
clare: undo toast should be keyboard-focusable and include an explicit close. aria-live polite announce like "Filters cleared. Undo available." Also ensure toast dismissal returns focus sensibly
toni: compare table sorting: add a little caret dropdown on badge headers to let users pick median/p99/cost as sort key. default sort = median latency. advanced sorts tucked under "More sorts"
sasha: implementation note: backend metadata already exposes median/p99/cost per-version. we'll add sort_key param to the compare endpoint. product: confirm default and if user preference should persist
ben: preference persistence seems useful for power users. also add a small "Save compare layout" pill for teams to pin layout + pinned items when sharing links
clare: share behavior: when creating a share link, snapshot current pins and filters and mark the view as read-only snapshot. include a "Fork into my compare" CTA for viewers to adopt pins
a11y-bot: Added thread checklist: aria-expanded on summarizer, focus management on expand, aria-labels for badges, aria-live pin announcements, prefers-reduced-motion support, toast accessibility
preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://ci.redwood.dev/previews/1940123456. Includes: filter summarizer, adaptive badges, pinned dock, keyboard cheat sheet overlay
sasha: thanks all. Next steps: ben to wire adaptive badge CSS + aria-labels, clare to write the accessibility acceptance criteria and unit test cases, toni to sketch pin dock variants. I'll update Figma with the summary panel and cheat sheet :thumbsup:
